description: This file is a Bash shell script providing helper functions and commands for managing Docker containers, project configuration, and interactions with the OpenClaw platform. It includes functions for starting/stopping containers, viewing logs, managing configuration, handling device pairings, and opening web interfaces, all tailored to the OpenClaw Docker environment.

methods.name: _clr_cmd
methods.description: Helper function for styled command output with green and bold formatting.

methods.name: _clawdock_trim_quotes
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string value.

methods.name: _clawdock_mask_value
methods.description: Replaces sensitive or lengthy values with redacted placeholders for masking.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_config_dir
methods.description: Reads the configuration directory path from the ~/.clawdock/config file.

methods.name: _clawdock_ensure_dir
methods.description: Ensures the CLAWDOCK_DIR is set and points to a valid directory with docker-compose.yml.

methods.name: _clawdock_compose
methods.description: Runs docker-compose commands with the appropriate configuration files.

methods.name: _clawdock_read_env_token
methods.description: Reads the OpenClaw Gateway token from the .env file in the project directory.
